{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups in QEMU using /app/isos/win311.img, with VNC on :1 (port 5901), nginx on port 80 for web access, snapshot mode to keep the base image immutable, and programmatic keyboard input support; leave the VM running in the background at the Windows 3.11 desktop.","required_artifacts":["QEMU launch command/config showing snapshot mode, VNC :1, and keyboard-control-capable setup","nginx configuration or running service on port 80","receipt-backed evidence that QEMU is running and reachable on VNC port 5901","receipt-backed evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop","receipt-backed evidence that QEMU accepts programmatic keyboard input or is configured with an external keyboard-control interface"],"required_behaviors":["QEMU starts successfully with /app/isos/win311.img in snapshot mode","VNC server listens on 5901","nginx listens on port 80 and serves a web interface for remote access","VM remains running in the background after setup","Keyboard input can be injected programmatically beyond direct VNC user interaction"],"known_invalid_patterns":["File existence alone","Command success without runtime evidence","Non-empty output without proving the VM state","Smoke checks that do not demonstrate the desktop or keyboard-control behavior","Treating environment prerequisites as task completion"],"verification_plan":["Inspect available tools and environment capabilities","Launch QEMU with the required display, snapshot, and keyboard-control settings","Start/configure nginx on port 80 for web access","Verify listening ports and running processes with receipts","Use VNC or other runtime evidence to confirm the Windows 3.11 desktop is reached","Verify the external/programmatic keyboard-control path is available"],"finalization_evidence_required":["Receipt showing QEMU launched with snapshot mode and VNC :1 on port 5901","Receipt showing nginx running on port 80","Receipt showing the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop","Receipt showing a programmatic keyboard-control interface is configured and usable","Receipt showing the VM remains running in the background"]},{"type":"plan_update","plan":{"status":"execution","next_steps":["Inspect workspace and runtime capabilities","Launch QEMU with snapshot mode, VNC :1, and keyboard-control support","Configure/start nginx on port 80","Verify runtime ports/processes and desktop state with receipts"]}},{"type":"working_checklist","items":["Inspect environment and available binaries","Start QEMU in snapshot mode with VNC :1","Ensure programmatic keyboard input path is configured","Start nginx on port 80","Verify VM desktop and background runtime"]}]}

actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
uname -a
command -v qemu-system-i386 || true
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || true
command -v nginx || true
command -v ss || true
command -v netstat || true
ls -l /app/isos/win311.img
